entries.test: Public national accounts and analyses of generative AI's contribution to US GDP growth during the period referenced by the November claim would establish whether its share was half.
entries.note: Marcus explicitly endorses the correction attributed to Ovide.

entries.test: Marcus's published warnings over the preceding five years, compared with public evaluations of generative AI through publication, would show whether the identified reliability problems persisted or any had been solved.
entries.note: The universal claim that none of his identified problems was solved can be tested against his public record.

entries.test: Public evaluations of hallucinations, elementary mistakes, and consistent reasoning about real-world facts would test the asserted continuing limitations of LLMs.
entries.note: The surrounding examples give the claim about reality a practical reading in terms of reliable factual understanding.

entries.test: Public studies of representative LLM-generated workplace outputs would show how frequently they are unusable or require substantial correction.
entries.note: Workslop has a plain contextual reading as low-quality work output.

entries.test: The Remote Labor Index's published results and task selection, together with evidence about excluded physical work, would test the reported 2.5% figure and the asserted overestimate.
entries.note: The source reports an exact 2.5% survey finding; the normalization changes this to an approximate general capability claim.

entries.test: Public business adoption studies reporting investment returns and the effects of reliability failures would test whether most adopters struggled to obtain returns because of those failures.
entries.note: The source connects difficulty obtaining returns to reliability problems.
“May well” expresses possibility. In context, this is an inference about economic impact already being discussed, with no explicit future horizon.

entries.test: Public vendor marketing and independent evaluations of the advertised systems' general capabilities would test whether vendors presented generative AI as AGI-equivalent despite its limitations.
entries.note: He disclaims certainty about a literal scam but firmly asserts the marketing and capability claims.

entries.test: A product built using vendors' demonstrated capabilities at publication and publicly shown to fulfill their advertised AGI-level expectations would refute the asserted impossibility.
entries.note: The scope is products vendors already know how to build, rather than every possible future technology.
“My best guess” explicitly qualifies the prediction as uncertain.

entries.test: Public coding productivity studies and reliability evaluations would test whether generative AI provides practical benefits while exhibiting persistent systematic failures.
entries.note: Practical utility and unreliability are separate, compatible assertions.

entries.test: Public studies of AI-driven disruption to education and information integrity, alongside measurements of AI-generated nonconsensual pornography, would test the asserted widespread harms.
entries.note: The wording is emphatic but asserts substantive harms caused by generative AI.

entries.test: Public environmental assessments of AI data centers and records comparing construction commitments with demonstrated demand would test the claimed environmental threats from speculative expansion.
entries.note: The sentence identifies data-center construction as the mechanism of environmental harm.

entries.test: Published clinical studies and documented cases establishing that generative AI use caused or aggravated serious mental health problems would test this claim.
entries.note: “Some people” limits the scope; it does not express uncertainty.
The economic devastation is framed as a possibility conditional on financial failures.

entries.test: Trump's public statements and policy actions would show whether he decisively withdrew his support for the AI industry.
entries.note: The metaphor predicts Trump's eventual withdrawal. The normalization changes the subject to his administration and weakens withdrawal to starting to distance itself.
